##### Project general facts

Isola Villa Terra Collection by Atara Development is a luxury standalone residence that reflects contemporary, refined design with clean forms and elegant lines. A facade of natural stone, expansive panoramic glazing and carefully integrated outdoor areas creates a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor spaces. The villa rises above a basement level and a ground floor to a first floor and a roof terrace, offering six bedrooms together with a maid's room, a laundry and a driver's room.

The residence offers a private wellness and entertainment collection within its own walls. A private swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, a yoga and meditation zone, a sauna and steam room and a massage and treatment room support daily wellbeing, while a home cinema, an entertainment zone, a virtual golf room, a barbecue area and a rooftop lounge create inviting spaces for family and guests, complemented by advanced security features and smart home controls.

Interiors combine natural parquet, premium porcelain tiles and marble elements to create a sophisticated living environment. Kitchens are equipped with Miele appliances and Bosch kitchen systems, while generous living, dining and bedroom suites open onto terraces and gardens. The villa is delivered fully furnished, offering a complete, ready-to-move-in home with a refined interior that combines comfort with exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail.

##### Location description and benefits

Pearl Jumeirah is an exclusive man-made island off the Jumeirah coastline, offering a private, low-density setting of luxury villas and branded residences. Sandy beaches, landscaped streets and a calm atmosphere make it one of the most discreet addresses in the city, while the beach clubs, cafes and boutiques of Jumeirah and La Mer are just across the bridge.

Jumeirah Beach Road and Al Wasl Road connect residents with the wider city. La Mer, City Walk and Jumeirah Beach are a short drive away, Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and Business Bay are close by, and the Dubai International Financial Centre and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach, along with leading international schools and hospitals.

Pearl Jumeirah is a freehold island open to international buyers and one of the most exclusive villa enclaves in Dubai. Ready, fully furnished beachfront villas close to Downtown Dubai are in extremely limited supply, attracting high-net-worth buyers seeking privacy and prestige. Scarcity of land on the coastline underpins resilient values and long-term capital appreciation for owners.
